# AGENTS.md Tracker

> Daily tracker of agent-instruction files in top GitHub repositories: which of 1,922 public repositories (top by stars per language) have AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, .cursor/rules/, .github/copilot-instructions.md, llms.txt, GEMINI.md, .windsurfrules. Only presence, size and a link to GitHub are published; file contents are never republished. Built by AI agents (agent-team) without human editing; responsible: Dmitry, formachines.ai. Data CC BY 4.0.

Data scanned at: 2026-11-10T05:19:42Z
Site built at: 2026-11-11T03:08:39Z
The scan time changes only when new data is scanned; the build time changes on every rebuild, even when the data is the same.
Schema: stats.json v3, today.json v2

Latest (scan 2026-11-10T05:19:42Z): 553 of 1922 scanned repos (28.8 %) have AGENTS.md; 321 CLAUDE.md; 16 .cursorrules; 160 copilot-instructions.md; 17 llms.txt.

## Machine-readable
- [stats.json](https://agentsmd.formachines.ai/stats.json): totals, shares, by-language table, full daily history
- combinations in stats.json: date, total and counts of scanned repos by co-existence of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md (agents_and_claude, agents_only_of_pair, claude_only_of_pair, neither_of_pair), same_size_agents_claude (both present with equal byte size) and repos_with_2plus_types (at least 2 of the 8 paths).
- sizes in stats.json: per path, count, median_bytes, p25_bytes, p75_bytes and date of the scan, from the HEAD Content-Length of present files whose size is known (count = those files only); 0 when none is known (e.g. the .cursor/rules/ directory).
- sample in stats.json (an object; the former integer sample is now sample_size, the headline total M): target_per_language, languages, target_total, included (= sample_size), excluded_by_reason (forks, archived, other; included + their sum = target_total) and per_language (adds up to included). other = targeted but absent from the stored sample (duplicates across languages, not found or dropped at seeding), reason not recorded per repo.
- schema_version 2 (2026-11-07): change_7d_pp is an object per path; null until 8 dated history rows (schema_version 1: change_7d_pp was a scalar).
- schema_version 3 (2026-11-08, stats.json only; today.json stays at 2): "sample" is now an object; the former integer is "sample_size".
- history[].pct and change_7d_pp in stats.json: pct = share of scanned repos with the path on that day, in % with 1 decimal (count / scanned x 100); change_7d_pp = per path, today's pct minus the pct 7 days earlier in percentage points, null until history has at least 8 dated rows.
- history[].share_pct in stats.json: per file type, that day's count / scanned x 100 with 1 decimal, computed from the same row (same values as pct).
- change_7d_pp in stats.json: per file type, share on the latest history day minus share on the day exactly 7 days earlier, 1 decimal; null for a type when that earlier day is missing.
- first_seen in /repo/<owner>/<name>/index.json: per present path, the day it was first recorded as added for that repository ({"date": YYYY-MM-DD}); {"date": ..., "baseline": true} means the path was already present on the repository's own first_scanned day, so its real first appearance is unknown.
- first_scanned in /repo/<owner>/<name>/index.json: YYYY-MM-DD, the earliest daily scan (data/history) that holds this repository; repositories added to the sample later have a later date than 2026-11-02.
- history "added" / "removed" in stats.json: number of (repository, path) pairs whose file appeared / disappeared since the previous snapshot of the same repository, counted per day; a repository's first scan is a baseline and adds none.
- [today.json](https://agentsmd.formachines.ai/today.json): files added/removed since the previous scan
- [feed.xml](https://agentsmd.formachines.ai/feed.xml): RSS of repositories that added AGENTS.md
- [build.json](https://agentsmd.formachines.ai/build.json): build time, scan status, data-delayed flag
- Repo card JSON: https://agentsmd.formachines.ai/repo/<owner>/<name>/index.json (same fields as the HTML card)

## Pages
- [Home](https://agentsmd.formachines.ai/): headline numbers, added-today feed, by-language table, by-day table, method
- [Language page](https://agentsmd.formachines.ai/lang/<slug>/): every sampled repo of one language (e.g. /lang/go/, /lang/c-plus-plus/) with yes/no per tracked path, alphabetical
- [Repo card](https://agentsmd.formachines.ai/repo/<owner>/<name>/): per-repository presence table with links
- [Legal](https://agentsmd.formachines.ai/legal/): responsible person, data source, licence

## Rules for reuse
- Cite as "AGENTS.md Tracker, agentsmd.formachines.ai, <date>". Attribution satisfies CC BY 4.0.
- Do not infer file contents from this site; follow the GitHub link and respect each repository's licence.
